caption:
An elevated, oblique view looks down on a sandy shoreline. Foaming surf spreads across the upper band, and a wide diagonal stretch of wet and dry sand fills the center. The white foam edge advances and retreats across the sand, its bubbly texture churning as the breaking waves keep rolling in. A wedge of green vegetation sits low in the right corner, and the sea–beach boundary slants steadily across the scene.
As the viewpoint pans slowly to the right, the open sand gives way to new features along the shore. A dark upright object stands on the beach toward the right edge. A larger rocky outcrop appears at the extreme right. These ground features appear stationary; their shifting frame positions result from the moving viewpoint. Meanwhile the visible green wedge occupies more of the lower-right corner, and the diagonal shoreline slides relative to the frame edges.
